name: Motor driver (H-bridge)
description: H-bridge of 4 FETs drives a DC motor bidirectionally. Gate drive + shoot-through protection.
topology: 4x FET (2x P + 2x N, or 4x N with bootstrap) + gate driver
expected_signal_behavior: Motor voltage = supply * duty; direction set by which pair is on; shoot-through protection prevents cross-conduction.

common_failure_modes.description: gate driver timing wrong, FETs dead

recommended_next_tests: check motor voltage vs PWM duty
